HOW SYGNIA CAN HELP
Sygnia’s Incident Response Service provides fast, comprehensive breach response across cloud, on-premise IT, OT, blockchain, and supply-chain environments, using vendor-agnostic technology that integrates easily with commercial and proprietary data sources for full investigative visibility.
Our responders apply a holistic, multi-pronged approach that goes beyond traditional digital forensics, guiding organizations through every phase of the incident lifecycle from scoping and containment to full remediation and recovery.
As a boutique company with global reach and incident responders located worldwide, we have over a decade of experience investigating some of the most complex incidents in complex environments.
Download the Datasheet
OUR APPROACH
Holistic cyber breach response powered by Sygnia’s purpose-built, technology agnostic Velocity Threat Detection Investigation and Response (TDIR) platform.
Velocity optimizes forensic investigation results at scale by ingesting data from all sources, including client-developed proprietary tools.
All engagements are performed exclusively by in-house experts who relentlessly eradicate the threat actor.
Every phase of the incident lifecycle is approached with the attacker mindset, based on our unmatched understanding of evolving adversaries and their advanced tactics, techniques, and procedures (TTPs).
Incident response activities are handled in parallel across multiple workstreams from executive and technical crisis management, containment, investigation, ransomware negotiation, remediation and recovery, and threat monitoring.
Contact an Expert
SYGNIA’S MULTI-PRONGED INCIDENT RESPONSE APPROACH
Executive Crisis Management
Lead executive teams through the crisis and provide evidence-based answers to stakeholders, employees, and the general public.
Containment
Ensure that areas not yet impacted by the attack will not be compromised; preventing further damage to the business.
Investigation
Perform triage and investigation to gain a complete picture of the attack and threat level; identifying attack vectors, timelines, and capabilities to be remediated.
Ransomware Negotiation
Leverage expert negotiators to gain critical time and feed valuable information from the attacker back to the investigative team; lowering ransom demands.
Remediation and Recovery
Execute a rapid return to full business operations; closing security gaps, eradicating the attacker, and minimizing overall breach impact.
Threat Monitoring
Perform tailored monitoring during and after the incident; ensuring additional malicious activities and re-entry attempts are blocked immediately.
SWIFTLY DEFEAT THE ATTACK

FAQs
Can Sygnia use my existing tools to confidently and successfully close an incident in my network?
Yes. Sygnia’s incident response capabilities are product agnostic. Our purpose-built Velocity Threat Detection Investigation and Response (TDIR) platform is technology agnostic to optimize forensic investigation results at scale by ingesting data from all sources, including client-developed proprietary tools
What is the difference between an incident response service and an incident response retainer?
An Incident Response (IR) Service is the actual hands-on work performed during or immediately after a security incident; activated once an incident is detected. An Incident Response Retainer (IRR) Service is a service that that provides pre-established terms and conditions before an incident occurs and guarantees priority access to incident response services. Sygnia offers several IRR tiers to fit each business’s unique needs.
Will I have to call upon additional vendors to help complete the full breach response?
No. Sygnia’s Incident Response Service provides end-to-end workstreams that cover the entire lifecycle of an incident in parallel from executive and technical crisis management, containment, investigation, ransomware negotiation and recovery, remediation and recovery, and threat monitoring—eliminating the need for any additional third-party vendors.
How can I ensure the threat actor will not return?
Sygnia’s Incident Response Service offers threat monitoring as part of the engagement, which provides tailored monitoring during and after the incident to ensure additional malicious activities and re-entry attempts by the attacker are blocked immediately.
How does the Velocity platform improve incident response outcomes?
Sygnia’s Velocity TDIR platform is purpose-built to commence and conduct response investigations more rapidly in any IT and OT environment, from the very first moment. This advanced technology collects, processes, and queries vast amounts of data from a variety of sources in near real-time. It provides speed and efficiency in threat hunting, threat detection, forensic investigation, and response.
